name: baron
description: Baron helps you plan a business with AI. Explore public Auto Units businesses for ideas, define who you will serve and what you will sell, and prepare a business brief. Open the brief in Baron, sign in by email, and review the details before approving setup. The public connector prepares your idea; it does not create or run a business, take payments, or access private accounts. Published examples do not guarantee revenue, profit, availability, or automatic setup.

positive.description: Explore ideas for starting a business with AI
positive.prompt: I want to start a business with AI. Show me examples and help me prepare a business brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Browse public examples with an empty query rather than searching the whole question. Return published profiles and website links, then ask for the customer, offering, and delivery method before preparing a brief. Do not claim to create a business or guarantee success.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the public connector cannot start work or execute financial transactions. Direct the person to Baron for authenticated review.
